title: Refuse contempt at its source
summary: Guru Nanak answers contempt with reality: human life, friendship, lineage, and kings themselves come through woman.
takeaway: Stop any speech that dishonors the source of life.
lifeApplication: When a joke, habit, or argument lowers women, interrupt it plainly. Let reverence become conduct before the room moves on.

source.shortMeaning: Guru Nanak rebukes contempt by naming woman as the source through whom human life continues.
source.lifeApplication: When contempt enters speech, refuse language that insults the source of life.

evidence.coreClaim: Guru Nanak rebukes contempt by naming woman as the source through whom human life continues.
evidence.turn: The teaching makes misogynistic speech answer to the reality it depends on — birth, friendship, lineage, and even kings come through woman.
evidence.practicalImplication: When a joke, habit, or argument lowers women, interrupt it plainly. Let reverence become conduct before the room moves on.
